notes.title: Uhilant Revealed: Trailer Live, Demo Coming Soon
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello, Uhilants![/b][/p][p]The game’s Steam page has just received a much-needed critical update (something that honestly should have been there since day one).[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Trailer Added![/b]
I’ve put together a trailer that captures the cozy yet tense atmosphere of the game, showing off its puzzles, enemies, and mechanics you’ll face along the journey.[/p][p]The game draws heavy inspiration from the [i]GO[/i]-style series (more [i]Hitman GO[/i] than [i]Deus Ex GO[/i]), but expands on the formula with new enemy types, fresh tools, and a layered story to uncover.[/p][p]At its heart, the game carries an [b]anti-war message[/b], blending my personal reflections on “the Uhilants,” “the War,” and the creeping virus of [i]The Mortido[/i]—the force that drives nations toward self-destruction.[/p][p][/p][h3]What’s Next?[/h3][p]I’m working on a [b]demo featuring the first 5–7 levels[/b], so you can experience the vibe of [i]Uhilant[/i] firsthand.[/p][p]Your feedback means a lot—please share your thoughts![/p][p][/p][p]Have a great weekend,
[b]– Bovtik, developer[/b][/p]
